findings.title: Unresolved failed critical test contradicts release conclusion
findings.observation: The validation conclusion states that all acceptance criteria were met despite an unresolved failed critical test case.
findings.source_text: Validation conclusion: all acceptance criteria were met. OQ-044 Result: Fail; Status: Open.
findings.impact: Release could be approved without evidence that a critical control operates as intended.
findings.suggested_redline: Validation release is not supported until OQ-044 is resolved and successfully retested.

findings.title: Unexpected result closure criteria are undefined
findings.observation: The OQ protocol does not define required handling and closure criteria for unexpected test results.
findings.source_text: Unexpected results must be linked to a controlled deviation or defect.
findings.impact: Validation exceptions may be closed without documented impact assessment.
findings.suggested_redline: Unexpected results shall be documented, assessed for validation impact, dispositioned, and linked to a controlled deviation prior to protocol closure.

findings.title: Session timeout differs across controlled documents
findings.observation: The URS specifies 15 minutes while the OQ acceptance criterion specifies 30 minutes.
findings.impact: Testing may verify the wrong approved security behavior.
findings.suggested_redline: Use the approved session timeout consistently in the URS, configuration baseline, and OQ.

findings.title: Controlled configuration baseline is not identified
findings.observation: The protocol references system configuration but does not identify the controlled baseline used during execution.
findings.impact: The tested configuration cannot be reconciled to the released baseline.
findings.suggested_redline: Verify the approved configuration baseline and record its identifier.
findings.modified_recommendation: Verify configuration baseline CFG-MARS-2.0 and attach the executed comparison report.

findings.title: Acceptance wording may be ambiguous
findings.observation: The result is described as appropriate without an observable threshold.
findings.source_text: The response time shall be appropriate.
findings.suggested_redline: The response time shall not exceed two seconds.

findings.title: Repeated prerequisite text could be consolidated
findings.observation: Consider consolidating repeated prerequisite statements to improve protocol readability.
findings.impact: The repetition does not affect validation adequacy but increases review effort.
findings.suggested_redline: Consolidate common prerequisites in the protocol prerequisite section.
